sources.name: NIST ASD
sources.role: levels, ground states, ionization energies; not collision cross sections

sources.name: OPEN-ADAS
sources.role: ADF04 LS levels, A and Maxwellian upsilon; native/canonical CSV adapter also available

sources.name: CCC
sources.role: energy-resolved electron-impact cross sections; projectile and units explicitly checked

sources.name: LXCat
sources.role: common BOLSIG/LXCat exports imported only with explicit state mapping and units; no account or browser scraping

sources.name: UMIST Rate22
sources.role: state-integrated thermal reaction candidates; photorates and unsupported laws retained separately

sources.name: KIDA
sources.role: additional source for manual curation/canonical input; no KIDA-specific automatic parser is claimed

sources.name: IAEA ALADDIN/AMBDAS
sources.role: additional published collision data to curate through canonical CSV; no universal parser is claimed

sources.name: He et al. 2025
sources.role: He*-He* Penning/association and He2+ recombination model coefficients, table A1

sources.name: Roberge & Dalgarno 1982
sources.role: He*-H total ionization and AI branching endpoints; interpolation explicitly labelled

sources.name: Lindsay & Stebbings 2005
sources.role: H+-H resonant charge transfer energy cross section; stated validity domain
